meta.rule: Only what you have proven you own and confirmed is scanned.

rule: Scanning your external surface is active scanning, so Vedette sets two conditions. First, you prove ownership: a domain with a DNS TXT record (re-checked right before every scan), a public IP only when this box itself reaches the Internet through it (valid for 90 days). Second, you confirm that your company owns it and you are authorized to scan it. Without both, the scan button stays locked. Every verification and scan is written to the audit log.

step.verifyHintDomain: Prove the domain is yours with a DNS TXT record, so nobody can enter someone else's domain.
step.verifyHintIp: This IP is verified because this box reaches the Internet through it. Verification lasts 90 days.
step.commitHint: One confirmation per target. Vedette records who confirmed it and when.

verify.failToast: Not verified yet. The reason is shown just below the button.
verify.recheckHint: Select it after you have saved the record at your DNS provider.
verify.dnsIntro: Add a TXT record to the DNS of {{value}}. Do it where you manage the domain (your registrar, Cloudflare, or whoever hosts your DNS).
verify.dnsHint: This record only proves you control the DNS. It gives Vedette no other access. Paste the value without quotes. If your DNS provider appends the domain to the Name field automatically, type just @. DNS usually updates within minutes, can take up to 72 hours (as in Google domain verification guidance). Keep the record until Vedette confirms verification; you can delete it afterwards.
verify.doneDomain: Verified with a DNS TXT record on {{time}}. Vedette re-checks the record right before every scan.
verify.keepRecord: Keep the TXT record in DNS: if it disappears, scanning is blocked until you add it back.
verify.txtMissing: Vedette could not find the TXT record at the last check, so scanning is blocked. Add the record back, then select Check again.
verify.ipIntro: This IP was verified because the box reaches the Internet through it.
verify.ipExpired: Verification expired, so this IP cannot be scanned. Route the box through this IP again (for example switch WAN), then verify again.
verify.ipRecheckHint: Works only while this box currently reaches the Internet through {{value}}. With several public IPs, route the box through this one first.

delete.title: Delete {{value}}?
delete.body: The snapshots and your confirmation for this target are removed from the box. The audit log is kept. This cannot be undone.

boxIp.title: Verify this box's public IP
boxIp.description: Vedette verifies a public IP only when this box itself reaches the Internet through it.
boxIp.how: The box connects to a fixed endpoint over TLS (Cloudflare /cdn-cgi/trace) and reads the IP address it uses to reach the Internet.
boxIp.result: That IP is added as verified for 90 days. Verify it again before it expires.
boxIp.why: You cannot type an IP. Only an address the box really uses proves it belongs to your network, so nobody can verify someone else's address.
boxIp.refuse: Private, reserved and shared carrier (CGNAT, 100.64.0.0/10) addresses are refused, because scanning them could hit other people.
boxIp.limit: At most 10 verification attempts per hour, and every attempt is written to the audit log.
boxIp.multi: Several public IPs? Route the box through each one in turn (for example switch WAN) and verify each.
